resources.string: Eliminate those who stand in your path.
Kill players by using your dope abilities!\%nl\%Preferably, explode \%b\%only\%/b\% in a secluded area.
The Sentinel is a Neutral Killing role that can explode themselves to kill anyone nearby. They may also kill normally, but where's the fun in that?
Teleport to places around the map.
Open the map and click anywhere on it to \%b\%teleport\%/b\% there.
The Apparater is a Crewmate Power role that can open the map and click a location to instantly teleport there.
Open the map. Click anywhere on it to teleport to that location.
Turn invisible when no one is watching.
You turn \%b\%invisible\%/b\% whenever nobody can see you.
The Invisible Boy is a Crewmate Support role that turns invisible whenever no living player has line of sight to him. The moment anyone can see even a sliver of him, he is visible again.
While no living player can see you, you are invisible - hidden from players, cameras, and the admin table. You see yourself as a ghostly outline. Dead players don't count; players in vents do.
Phase into an \%b\%invisible spirit\%/b\% that walks through walls.\%nl\%When your tether breaks, you snap back to where you phased from.

The Astral is an Impostor Concealing role that can phase into a spirit form: invisible, able to walk through walls, and still able to kill. When the form ends they are pulled back to the spot they phased from, staying invisible for a few seconds longer to slip away.
Become an invisible spirit that walks through walls and can still kill. When the form ends, you return to where you phased from and remain invisible briefly.
Mark a target and \%b\%trace\%/b\% their location.\%nl\%Assassinate them to become \%b\%invisible\%/b\%.
The Ninja is an Impostor Assassin role that can mark players and see their trace. When they assassinate a marked target, they become invisible for a brief period to slip away unnoticed.
Mark a target player and see their trace on the map.
Kill your marked target and become invisible.
Cast a hex upon your foes.
\%b\%Hex\%/b\% your targets during the game.\%nl\%They will die at the next meeting unless they're protected or you're voted out.
The Witch is an Impostor Curse role that can hex players. Hexed players will die at the next meeting unless the Witch is voted out before then or the hex is somehow lifted.
Curse a player to die at the next meeting.
Shoot the crew with your sniper.
\%b\%Aim\%/b\% and \%b\%snipe\%/b\% players from anywhere on the map.\%nl\%Precision kills from a distance.
The Sniper is an Impostor Marksman role that can aim at targets and take a piercing shot that kills from across the map. They have a limited aiming window to line up their shot.
Aim and fire a shot at a targeted player from anywhere on the map.
\%b\%Devour\%/b\% players to consume them.\%nl\%Win by being the last one alive.
The Pelican is a Neutral Killing role that can devour other players. They win alone when they are the only player left alive.
Consume a player to remove them from the game.
You are the head of the Mafia.\%nl\%The Mafioso answers to you and cannot act while you live.

The Godfather is an Impostor Killing role and the leader of the Mafia. They are a standard Impostor with kill and sabotage abilities. The Mafioso cannot kill or sabotage while the Godfather is alive, ensuring the hierarchy of the family.
Work with the Mafia to kill the Crewmates.
You work under the Godfather.\%nl\%You cannot kill or sabotage while they live, but you inherit their powers when they die.

The Mafioso is an Impostor Killing role and a member of the Mafia under the Godfather's command. While the Godfather lives, the Mafioso cannot kill or sabotage. When the Godfather dies, the Mafioso immediately gains full Impostor powers and becomes the new leader.
Work with the Mafia by hiding dead bodies.
You have a \%b\%clean\%/b\% button instead of a kill button.\%nl\%Use it to remove bodies and cover the Mafia's tracks.

The Mafia Janitor is an Impostor Support role that cleans up after the Mafia. Instead of a kill button, they have a clean button to remove bodies from the game, one at a time. This helps the Mafia avoid detection while covering their tracks.
Remove a dead body from the game.
Mark players and strip them of their role - immediately or at the next meeting.
\%b\%Mark\%/b\% your targets.\%nl\%At the next meeting's end, they lose their role and become plain Crewmates. Each use adds cooldown time.

The Eraser is an Impostor Support role that can mark players to be erased. At the end of each meeting's exile phase, all marked players lose their modded role and become plain Crewmates without being informed. Each use of the erase ability adds 10 seconds to the cooldown permanently.
Mark a player to lose their role at the next meeting's end.
\%b\%Eat\%/b\% dead bodies to consume them.\%nl\%When you've eaten enough, you win instantly.

The Vulture is a Neutral Scavenger role that can eat dead bodies, permanently removing them from the game. They can see arrows pointing to nearby corpses and win instantly once they have consumed the required number of bodies. They win alone and do not align with any other faction.
Consume a dead body, removing it from the game and increasing your meal count toward victory.
Hide players in your cloak to keep them safe.
\%b\%Hide\%/b\% a player in your cloak.\%nl\%They're protected until they pop back out.

Daddy Hagrid is a Crewmate Protective role that can hide a player in his cloak. A hidden player is invisible, untargetable, and rides along with Hagrid until the hide duration runs out, popping back out at his position. Unlike a certain hungry bird, a meeting releases them unharmed - and if Hagrid dies, they're released alive where he fell.
Tuck the nearest player into your cloak. They're hidden and protected until they pop back out.
Send your attackers somewhere far, far away.
Raise your \%b\%shield\%/b\%.\%nl\%Anyone who interacts with you while it's up is teleported across the map.

The Elusive is a Crewmate Protective role with a shield ability. While the shield is up, anyone who interacts with the Elusive - a kill attempt or a targeted ability - is blocked and instantly teleported to a random spot on the map. Attackers can't tell the shield is up until it's too late.
Raise a shield for a short duration. Anyone who interacts with you while shielded is teleported to a random spot on the map.
\%b\%Deploy\%/b\% an RC car to drive around.\%nl\%Press again to \%b\%detonate\%/b\% it in a radius.
The RC-XD is an Impostor Killing role that deploys a remote-controlled car. You freeze in place while driving it, and pressing the button again detonates it to kill everyone nearby.
Deploy an RC car at your feet. You freeze in place while driving it with movement controls.
Explode the RC car, killing all nearby players.
Throw on your \%b\%cloak\%/b\% to turn invisible for a short while.

The Invisibility Cloak is a Universal Modifier that grants its holder a Cloak button. Using it turns the holder completely invisible - hidden from players, cameras, and the admin table - for a short duration. Only the wearer (and the informed dead) see a faint outline.
Become invisible for a short duration.
\%b\%Slide tackle\%/b\% the nearest player, stunning them briefly.

The Slide Tackle is a Universal Modifier that grants its holder a Tackle button. Using it lunges the holder at the nearest player and knocks them down: the victim can't move, use abilities, or report for a short duration - but they can still be killed while down.
Lunge at the nearest player and stun them briefly.
